pages.text: $(thing)Apotheosis$() affixes are random modifiers that appear on weapons and armor dropped by mobs and bosses. $(thing)IridescentCraft$() adds $(bold)30 custom affix entries$() on top of Apotheosis's built-in pool.$(br2)Affixes also provide $(bold)gem sockets$(). Higher-rarity affixed items have more sockets. $(l:icraft:loot/gems)See the Gems entry$(/l) for socket details.

pages.title: Affix Tiers
pages.text: $(bold)Common$() — Available $(t1)Tier 1$()+. Mild bonuses. 0–1 sockets.$(br)$(bold)Uncommon$() — Available $(t2)Tier 2$()+. Moderate bonuses. 1–2 sockets.$(br)$(bold)Rare$() — Available $(t2)Tier 2$()+. Strong bonuses. 2 sockets.$(br)$(bold)Epic$() — Available $(t3)Tier 3$()+. Very strong bonuses. 2–3 sockets.$(br)$(bold)Legendary$() — Available $(t4)Tier 4$(). Exceptional bonuses. 3–4 sockets.$(br)$(bold)Mythic$() — Post-endgame Rift infusion only. Maximum bonuses. 4 sockets.

pages.title: Reforging
pages.text: $(thing)Apotheosis$()'s Reforging Station allows replacing an item's affixes with newly-rolled ones. $(thing)IridescentCraft$() adds three reforge token tiers that control the minimum affix quality:$(br2)$(bold)Basic Reforging Token$() — minimum Uncommon$(br)$(bold)Advanced Reforging Token$() — minimum Rare$(br)$(bold)Ultimate Reforging Token$() — minimum Epic$(br2)Tokens are crafted from boss materials. See $(l:icraft:loot/token_system)Tier Tokens$(/l) for recipes.

pages.title: Champion Affixes
pages.text: $(thing)Champions$() are elite mob variants (glowing) with special abilities. $(thing)IridescentCraft$() adds 5 custom Champion affixes beyond the built-in 16:$(br2)$(bold)Commanding$() — buffs nearby mobs$(br)$(bold)Draining$() — leeches your mana/XP on hit$(br)$(bold)Hexing$() — applies random debuffs$(br)$(bold)Leaping$() — closes distance instantly$(br)$(bold)Summoning$() — spawns reinforcements$(br2)Champions spawn at ~8% base rate and scale to higher rates in harder dimensions.
